verdict.rationale: Smooth's own CLI docs state the agent can work with files in both directions: you can give it files to upload to websites, and it can download files from the web for you. That covers the core upload/download story as a first-party feature. Retrievability is only implied by 'download files ... for you', with no documented mechanism. Missing for 10: documented artifact retrieval mechanism (API endpoint or storage/download location after the task), API/SDK-level file upload/download parameters beyond the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
